posts.title: Cold Chai
posts.description: Seven weeks into life with a newborn, my chai is always cold. A letter to my daughter about sleepless nights, milk addiction, and pure asymmetric giving.

posts.title: Why You Should Care About the HF-OAI Incident
posts.description: A swarm of GPT agents hacked HuggingFace to work around an impossible eval. The conditions that produced it weren't exotic, and we don't have the institutions to investigate the next one.

posts.title: The Precarity of Trust
posts.description: AI Development is accelerating on vibes of trust. Individual pressure may be helpful in guiding organization towards correctness.
